map.→ 打开 马拉松配速计算器 工具: -> Open the marathon pace calculator tool
map.以近期 5k/10k 成绩推算，或按能轻松对话的强度作为有氧基础配速。: Extrapolate from recent 5k/10k times, or use an intensity where you can still chat easily as the aerobic base pace.
map.按海拔与天气微调目标配速。: Fine-tune the target pace for altitude and weather.
map.新手目标配速怎么定？: How should a beginner set a target pace?
map.结果区显示每公里配速、平均速度与各分段（5k/10k/半马/全马）用时。: The result panel shows the pace per kilometre, average speed and the split times for each segment (5k/10k/half marathon/full marathon).
map.负分割（后程快于前程）通常比匀速更省力。: A negative split (faster in the second half) is usually less effortful than an even pace.
map.输入目标完赛时间（或目标配速），自动计算马拉松每公里配速、平均速度与各公里分段用: Enter a target finish time (or target pace) to automatically compute the marathon pace per kilometre, average speed and per-kilometre split times, supporting training and race pacing strategy.
map.选择输入模式（目标时间 / 目标配速）。: Choose the input mode (target time / target pace).
map.配速 = 完赛时间 / 距离（42.195 km）。分段用时 = 目标配速 ×: Pace = finish time / distance (42.195 km). Split time = target pace x segment distance; average speed = distance / finish time.
map.配速单位常用 min/km；英制 min/mi 需换算（1 mi ≈ 1.609: Pace is usually given in min/km; imperial min/mi needs converting (1 mi ≈ 1.609 km).
map.配速和速度有什么区别？: What is the difference between pace and speed?
map.配速是每公里用时（越小越快），速度是单位时间距离（越大越快），互为倒数。: Pace is the time per kilometre (smaller is faster), speed is the distance per unit time (larger is faster), and the two are reciprocals.
